comparison.objective: Align a loose splash-shield panel with a body hole and push a retaining clip home; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hole alignment, part stabilization, clip insertion, and snap retention versus coupled screw/nut countertorque with separate tools.
comparison.success_condition: Requires holes within 1.5 mm, panel flat, clip upright and seated flush, and one-second stillness; candidate requires angular accuracy, nut retention, three cycles, and drift control.
comparison.reason: Both combine stabilization with fastening, but the record tests aligning two bodies for push-clip insertion rather than preserving an adjustable threaded setting during locking.
